hypotheses.justification: The existing proof works unchanged without this binder. FiniteGroupPresentation requires only Group and TopologicalSpace; the forward direction transfers compactness and total disconnectedness along its homeomorphism. In the reverse direction, ProfiniteGrp.of requires Group, TopologicalSpace, IsTopologicalGroup, CompactSpace, and TotallyDisconnectedSpace, but not T2Space (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Category/ProfiniteGrp/Basic.lean). Hausdorffness follows internally from total disconnectedness for topological groups. No nontriviality assumption is needed, so the trivial group is covered.
